Rakan spikes with W Grand Entrance (CD 14/13/12/11/10s) engage windows and R The Quickness (CD 130/110/90s) roam/charm; Milio's counter-spikes are first item (sustain uptime) and full items (R cleanses the charm).

edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: Shield your caught ally the instant Grand Entrance lands — spent even one beat late, it saves nothing at all.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: Chasing a Rakan roam into fog trades your vision lead for a kill he's already banked mobility from.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Breath of Life banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Rakan's Grand Entrance (W) is up every 14/13/12/11/10s — the knockup starts every play; track him in fog, his E extends it. - The Quickness (R) resets at 130/110/90s. - Bank your R for the fight it swings, not a habit.
